_comment: Published PAID per-token rates, used to compute notional cost from tokens
actually consumed on free tiers. See docs/COST_MODEL.md.
Entries start verified:false and CANNOT produce a cost until confirmed
against the vendor's own pricing page -- pricing.cost_usd() raises. An
invented rate is indistinguishable from a real one once it is plotted, so
the loader refuses rather than guesses.
To fill these in: run `make pricing`, confirm each rate against source_url,
then set verified:true. Lane A models have no per-token price at all and
are costed by GPU-hour rental equivalent instead (gpu-rental-<date>.json).

openrouter-free.note: Price the paid variant of the same weights, not the :free endpoint.
